pchewlo-aeo-check-aeo-check.description: Run aeo-check on a website's code (or a live URL) to find answer engine optimisation problems that stop ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, Gemini and Google AI Overviews from crawling, understanding, citing or buying from the site, then fix them. Use when asked to check or improve AEO, GEO, AI search visibility, llms.txt, robots.txt for AI crawlers, structured data, or agent readiness.
